## findings

**T0-F1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladder) — hours computation, factor `late_arrival`.**
- Symptom / root cause: charter-global finding F-G1 (`_difficulty.md` → findings): the 1-9-minute tier ("rounded to the nearest whole hour, half an hour rounding up") always yields 0, the fall-through's value.
- Demonstrated consequence on this world: the customer sits on tier 1 (697e17e1, 12 minutes → 1 hour) and the factor bears weight (baseline → 8 vs 7), but the near-miss the dossier names for it (50e43b99, 5 minutes; 8b9bcfb5, 3 minutes) would score 0 hours under either tier 2 or the fall-through, so the ladder offers this task only a two-way split (≥10 minutes vs not). Counting it out, the hours computation keeps 5 factors with 1 method (progression_clock) — bounds hold.
- Affected: `wc.extended.yaml` → `wc_ext_program_day_hours` rule late-arrival sentence, `compute.late_hours`, `factors[late_arrival]`; `tasks/0.json` computations[hours].factor_sensitivity[late_arrival] (figure correct, ladder unreal).
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

**T0-F2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladder / mislabelled method) — extension computation, factor `request_window`.**
- Symptom / root cause: charter-global finding F-G2: on a Work Hardening referral tier 1 ("whole weeks remaining, at least one", fewer than two left) and tier 2 ("one progress-report interval in whole weeks", 7 // 7) both give 1 week; the "method" tiers are constants.
- Demonstrated consequence on this world: weeks remaining = (56 − 44) // 7 = 1 → tier 1 → 1 week; the progress report is also overdue (9 > 7 days), so a reader who applied tier 2 instead also gets 1 week and the same 3 days — the tier boundary the factor claims to test cannot be told apart by the score. The factor still bears weight against its baseline (2 weeks → 6). Counting it out, the extension keeps 5 factors with 1 method (unused_day_netting) — bounds hold.
- Affected: `wc_ext_program_extension_days` rule request-window sentence, `compute.window_weeks`, `factors[request_window]`; `tasks/0.json` computations[extension].factor_sensitivity[request_window].
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

**T0-F3 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (false world assertion in the factor proof) — `tasks/0.json` design_rationale, factor card of `wc_ext_program_day_hours`.**
